title: Corner lifting for a parametrized adjunction
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E$ be categories [def-nagata-category], let $H:\mathcal C\times\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ and $R:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal E\to\mathcal D$ be bifunctors, and specify bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal E}(H(c,d),e)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(d,R(c,e))$$
natural in $c,d,e$ (a parametrized adjunction). Let $i:c_0\to c_1$, $j:d_0\to d_1$ and $p:e_0\to e_1$ be arrows. Assume the following pushout and pullback exist:
$$P=H(c_1,d_0)\amalg_{H(c_0,d_0)}H(c_0,d_1),\qquad Q=R(c_0,e_0)\times_{R(c_0,e_1)}R(c_1,e_1).$$
Here a pushout represents pairs of maps out of the two objects agreeing on their common source, and a pullback represents pairs of maps into the two objects agreeing after mapping to their common target. Let $i\mathbin{\square_H}j:P\to H(c_1,d_1)$ be induced by $H(c_1,j)$ and $H(i,d_1)$, and let $\langle i,p\rangle_R:R(c_1,e_0)\to Q$ be induced by $R(i,e_0)$ and $R(c_1,p)$. Write $a\perp b$ for the diagonal lifting property: every commutative square with left arrow $a$ and right arrow $b$ has a diagonal making both triangles commute. Then
$$(i\mathbin{\square_H}j)\perp p\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad j\perp\langle i,p\rangle_R.$$
No model structure or cofibrancy condition is assumed.
